description: This file defines a Smarty plugin for generating HTML checkboxes. It contains the main function 'smarty_function_html_checkboxes' which creates a list of checkbox inputs according to specified parameters, as well as helper functions for rendering individual checkbox elements. The plugin is intended to be used within Smarty templates to simplify checkbox generation in PHP web applications.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes
methods.description: Generates a list of HTML checkbox inputs based on provided parameters, with options for customization such as labels, separators, and pre-selected values.

methods.name: smarty_function_html_checkboxes_output
methods.description: Creates the HTML markup for a single checkbox input, with label if specified, and handles escaping and checked state.
